version.description:
Before sending an ID photo, add who it is for and what it may be used for. With Meward you can put a watermark across the image and cover details the recipient does not need to see.

Choose a photo or take one in the app. Type your own watermark and place it in the center, in a corner or in rows across the photo. Adjust the angle and opacity of a tiled watermark.

For screenshots and forms, Meward can suggest covers for Chinese names, mainland Chinese mobile numbers and resident ID numbers. Review each suggestion, move or remove a cover, or draw one yourself. A watermark appears above the covers. Preview the result and save a full-resolution PNG copy. Your original stays in place.

Photo editing and text recognition work entirely on your device, including offline with a locally stored photo. Meward reads only the photo you choose in the system picker and asks for camera access when you tap the camera. Saving a copy asks for permission to add it to Photos. You choose where a copy goes when you tap Share. No account, uploads, ads or tracking.
